# Current: Position E (rows 27-46, cols ~4-16)
# Let me check all 4 directions from here
# Track by the leftmost red pixel column

def get_char_pos(seg):
    red_nodes = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'r' and n['pixels'] >= 50]
    if not red_nodes:
        return None
    # Combine all red pixels to get full extent
    all_rows = []
    all_cols = []
    for n in red_nodes:
        for p in n['boundary']:
            all_rows.append(p[0])
            all_cols.append(p[1])
    return (min(all_rows), max(all_rows), min(all_cols), max(all_cols))

pos = get_char_pos(current_frame.segmentation)
print(f"Current: rows {pos[0]}-{pos[1]}, cols {pos[2]}-{pos[3]}")

# Try all 4 directions
for direction in ['UP', 'DOWN', 'LEFT', 'RIGHT']:
    result = action([direction])
    cells = last_action_result['executed_actions'][0]['animation']['total_cells_changed']
    pos = get_char_pos(current_frame.segmentation)
    print(f"  {direction}: cells={cells}, pos=rows {pos[0]}-{pos[1]}, cols {pos[2]}-{pos[3]}")
    
    # Reverse if moved
    if cells > 10:
        reverse = {'UP': 'DOWN', 'DOWN': 'UP', 'LEFT': 'RIGHT', 'RIGHT': 'LEFT'}
        result = action([reverse[direction]])
        pos = get_char_pos(current_frame.segmentation)
        print(f"    Reverse {reverse[direction]}: pos=rows {pos[0]}-{pos[1]}, cols {pos[2]}-{pos[3]}")

# Check level completion
print(f"Level completed: {last_action_result.get('level_completed', False)}")
